Rally extended after R1 and PDH were crossed.
Rally continued after PWH was crossed.

preregistered.name: R1/PDH breakout with VWAP + EMA context
preregistered.counting_starts: first NSE session after approved_on; nothing before approval is counted
preregistered.derived_from: C001 '+r1_pdh_break' variant, selected post-hoc (1 of 5 filter variants) in the 2026-10-16 backtest: all-days PF 1.42 points (IS 1.41 / OOS 1.44), modelled 1-lot ATM CE +Rs 141,963 over 612 trades, 10 real-price trades +Rs 5,050.

definition.sessions: every NSE session (no CPR / pivot setup filter)
definition.signal: first 5m bar whose close satisfies ALL: futures close > futures session VWAP; spot close > 5m EMA20, 5m EMA50, 5m EMA200 and 1m EMA200; spot close > max(daily Traditional R1, PDH)
definition.exit: first 5m CLOSE below the 5m EMA20 at or after the entry bar -> next 5m bar open; wicks do not count; force exit at the 15:20 bar open
definition.levels: R1 = 2P - L and PDH from the previous session (spot 09:15-15:29)
definition.option_traded: 1 lot (65) NIFTY CE, strike = entry spot rounded to nearest 50, nearest weekly expiry on/after the trade date
definition.option_price: real lastPrice from option_chain_snapshots.db at the first snapshot at/after each fill (max 10 min lag); modelled price reported alongside
definition.costs: nse_cost_model.NseCostModel, trade-date STT, plus 1 point premium slippage per side

simulated_from_backtest_trades.method: 5-trade block bootstrap of the 612 backtest trades, 20k reps; 'no edge' = same trades de-meaned

forward_bar_proposed.expected_duration: about 22 months at the out-of-sample rate of 6.9 trades/month

preregistered.frozen_after_approval: definition, costs and bar may not change once approved; any change = a new rule id with its own fresh forward window
